info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Cloud Inventory Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033/034). The discovery tool reports an AWS or Azure resource (the provider id is its identity: the same one again is 200 with the stored resource restated, a new one is 201), the snapshot is replaced by what the tool says now, the same ARN under another account is another resource, resources are read, listed with every filter and counted by provider, kind, state and presence, and a terminated resource is judged GONE and comes back when reported running. A second folder proves the service is staff only (403 ERR-INV-00403 for a REQUESTER on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (an unknown provider, kind or state, a provider id with a space or over 300, a name with a space, a region in capitals, a tag key that is not kept, a tag value with a person and an address, more than four tags, missing fields, a malformed account id, missing executor), tenant isolation, unknown filters and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (ciOrganisationId).
